∀ (k : Type u_1) (Q : Type u_2) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Quiver.{u_4, u_2} Q] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} Q]
  [inst_3 : Fintype.{u_2} Q] (B : Type u_3) [inst_4 : Ring.{u_3} B] [inst_5 : Algebra.{u_1, u_3} k B] (P : Q → B)
  (A : (i j : Q) → Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} i j → B),
  Eq.{u_3 + 1} (Finset.sum.{u_2, u_3} Finset.univ.{u_2} fun i => P i) 1 →
    (∀ (i : Q), Eq.{u_3 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_3, u_3, u_3} (P i) (P i)) (P i)) →
      (∀ (i j : Q), Ne.{u_2 + 1} i j → Eq.{u_3 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_3, u_3, u_3} (P i) (P j)) 0) →
        (∀ (i j : Q) (e : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} i j),
            Eq.{u_3 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_3, u_3, u_3} (A i j e) (P i)) (A i j e)) →
          (∀ (l i j : Q) (e : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} i j),
              Ne.{u_2 + 1} l i → Eq.{u_3 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_3, u_3, u_3} (A i j e) (P l)) 0) →
            (∀ (i j : Q) (e : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} i j),
                Eq.{u_3 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_3, u_3, u_3} (P j) (A i j e)) (A i j e)) →
              (∀ (l i j : Q) (e : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} i j),
                  Ne.{u_2 + 1} l j → Eq.{u_3 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_3, u_3, u_3} (P l) (A i j e)) 0) →
                ExistsUnique.{max (max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)} fun φ =>
                  And
                    (∀ (i : Q),
                      Eq.{u_3 + 1}
                        (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1),
                            max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), u_3 + 1}
                          φ (Etingof.Problem2_8_6.Book.vertexIdem.{u_1, u_2, u_4} k Q i))
                        (P i))
                    (∀ (i j : Q) (e : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} i j),
                      Eq.{u_3 + 1}
                        (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1),
                            max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), u_3 + 1}
                          φ (Etingof.Problem2_8_6.Book.arrowGen.{u_1, u_2, u_4} k Q e))
                        (A i j e))
